strings: m_c is absolutely certain that an outsider is following {PRONOUN/m_c/object} wherever they go and insists {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/need/needs} protection.
m_c is certain that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates despise {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} fur prickles when a Clanmate mentions that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/seem/seems} different.
m_c <i>knows<i/> {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} belief is a delusion, but that doesn't make {PRONOUN/m_c/object} believe it any less.
m_c scoffs when r_c0 offers herbs to calm {PRONOUN/m_c/object} down. Can't {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} tell that m_c has been chosen by StarClan to save all the Clans?
m_c comes crying into r_c0's den, insisting that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} teeth are falling out, even after repeated assurances that they're not.
Despite r_c0's assurances and m_c's knowledge that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} delusion isn't true, {PRONOUN/m_csubject} can't help but believe it.
